detailed_descriptions.en: Liquidation is a tactical Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game set in a universe that mixes elements of both fantasy and science fiction, with support for both single-player and multiplayer modes. Welcome to world of Veá Our story unfolds on the dying planet of Veá, where a sudden, cataclysmic event, known as the Splintering, wiped out entire species and destroyed thriving civilzations. In its wake, a strange, powerful substance, called Quenrium rose from the depths of the world. Discovery of life-sustaining properties of Quenrium, in a world starved for resources, led a conflict between the Twilight Crusade and the Scourge alliance over its possesion. Thus began the Quenrium War. Choose from 3 Factions. Twilight Crusade Fanatical zealots clad in radiant golden armor. Guided by unshakable faith, they seek absolute control of the planet and the eradication of all who oppose their holy mandate. Scourge Alliance A desperate coalition of Lamia tribes and technologically advanced Frogkin. United by necessity, they combine primal ferocity with cutting‑edge weaponry to survive against overwhelming threats. Legion Host of demons pouring into Veá through a tear in reality. Shapen by a godlike entity from the Nether realm, they only seek to do bidding of their master. Gameplay Liquidation delivers tightly balanced battles where every unit and ability serves a clear, intentional role. The game encourages thoughtful army composition and mid‑sized forces, striking a sweet spot between micro‑level control and macro‑level strategy. This creates a battlefield where smart tactical choices, clever positioning, and well-timed abilities can swing the tide and secure decisive advantages. Commanders Liquidation’s story is driven by powerful commanders who serve as the narrative centerpieces. Commanders level up and unlock new abilities as the campaign progresses. Commanders are not meant to overshadow the armies they lead. Even the strongest commander cannot stand alone. Every strength comes with a weakness. This creates a world where heroes matter, but armies remain essential.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Liquidation is a tactical Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game set in a universe that mixes elements of both fantasy and science fiction, with support for both single-player and multiplayer modes.

Welcome to world of Veá

Our story unfolds on the dying planet of Veá, where a sudden, cataclysmic event, known as the Splintering, wiped out entire species and destroyed thriving civilzations.

In its wake, a strange, powerful substance, called Quenrium rose from the depths of the world. Discovery of life-sustaining properties of Quenrium, in a world starved for resources, led a conflict between the Twilight Crusade and the Scourge alliance over its possesion.

Thus began the Quenrium War.

Choose from 3 Factions.

Twilight Crusade

Fanatical zealots clad in radiant golden armor. Guided by unshakable faith, they seek absolute control of the planet and the eradication of all who oppose their holy mandate.

Scourge Alliance

A desperate coalition of Lamia tribes and technologically advanced Frogkin. United by necessity, they combine primal ferocity with cutting‑edge weaponry to survive against overwhelming threats.

Legion

Host of demons pouring into Veá through a tear in reality. Shapen by a godlike entity from the Nether realm, they only seek to do bidding of their master.

Gameplay

Liquidation delivers tightly balanced battles where every unit and ability serves a clear, intentional role.

The game encourages thoughtful army composition and mid‑sized forces, striking a sweet spot between micro‑level control and macro‑level strategy. This creates a battlefield where smart tactical choices, clever positioning, and well-timed abilities can swing the tide and secure decisive advantages.

Commanders

Liquidation’s story is driven by powerful commanders who serve as the narrative centerpieces.

Commanders level up and unlock new abilities as the campaign progresses. Commanders are not meant to overshadow the armies they lead. Even the strongest commander cannot stand alone. Every strength comes with a weakness. This creates a world where heroes matter, but armies remain essential.
